fixture_gaps.description: PDF containing at least one embedded raster image for ImageExtractor to extract
fixture_gaps.implementation_approach: Create a PDF via Aspose.Pdf.Document with an Aspose.Pdf.Image added to a page paragraph collection. The image can be a minimal PNG or BMP generated in-memory. Requires a small programmatic image (e.g., 1x1 pixel PNG bytes) as the image source.

fixture_gaps.implementation_approach: Add table_generator_input_creation_lines to pdf.yml template_hints documenting the TableBuilder pattern. Add per_type_constraints for TableGenerator with REQUIRED: TableOptions + TableBuilder + TableRowBuilder + TableCellBuilder usage.

fixture_gaps.description: PDF with interactive AcroForm fields (text box, checkbox) programmatically created via Aspose.Pdf.Forms namespace
fixture_gaps.implementation_approach: Create a PDF with AcroForm fields using Aspose.Pdf core API (not LowCode). Add TextBoxField and CheckBoxField to a page. Save as input.pdf. This fixture is shared across all Form-family types.
sample_code: var textBox = new Aspose.Pdf.Forms.TextBoxField(page, new Aspose.Pdf.Rectangle(100, 700, 300, 720));

fixture_gaps.implementation_approach: Reuse AcroForm PDF from FG-005. Generate a JSON file with field_name: field_value pairs matching the form field names. FormJsonImportSource wraps this JSON file.

fixture_gaps.description: PKCS12 (.pfx) certificate file for digital signing. Can be self-signed using .NET X509Certificate2 APIs.
fixture_gaps.implementation_approach: Two options: (1) Generate self-signed cert inline in the C# example using System.Security.Cryptography.X509Certificates.CertificateRequest. (2) Ship a pre-generated test.pfx file as a binary fixture artifact. Option 2 is simpler but adds a binary to the repository.
sample_code: var req = new CertificateRequest("cn=TestSigner", rsa, HashAlgorithmName.SHA256, RSASignaturePadding.Pkcs1);

fixture_gaps.description: TSA (Timestamp Authority) server URL or offline timestamp stub for RFC 3161 timestamping
fixture_gaps.implementation_approach: Option 1: Use a public free TSA URL (e.g., http://timestamp.digicert.com) — requires network access. Option 2: Investigate if TimestampOptions supports PKCS9 local timestamps without network TSA. Option 3: Implement a minimal RFC 3161 response stub — significant infrastructure work.
fixture_gaps.external_dependency: Requires either: (a) network access to a public TSA server, or (b) a local TSA stub implementation. Neither is available in the current CI-safe test infrastructure.

fixture_gaps.description: A valid OFD (Open Fixed-layout Document) file conforming to GB/T 33190-2016 standard
fixture_gaps.implementation_approach: Source a valid OFD sample file from a public repository or Chinese government document portal. OFD is not programmatically generatable from current stack (no Python/C# OFD authoring library available). Must be sourced externally.
fixture_gaps.external_dependency: OFD format requires external sourcing. Cannot be generated programmatically from Aspose.Pdf API or current fixture infrastructure.
